reason: User decision 2026-05-24: standard must be SIZE-GATED (FULL vs LEAN). Brief revised. Edit list updated.
payload: Revised: size-gated build standard — two profiles selected by architect at handoff time. FULL (new apps/<svc>/): three-tier + G1-G12 + three-level dashboard + full PO-BA-architect-PM-dev-QA relay + pilot-status-<svc>.json. LEAN (feature on existing service): three-tier placement + fence + sandbox/replay + honest red/green DoD — one dev-<svc> agent solo, no relay, no per-feature dashboard or charter ceremony. 7 file edits: F1=create docs/standards/microservice-build-standard.md (seven sections, gate at top), F2=tree-map registration, F3a=lazy-load to 8 frontmatter agents, F3b=lazy-load to 4 knowledge.md children, F4=architect/main.md Step 5 two-branch emit (full/lean/not-applicable), F5=dev-team/main.md Step 2 size-gated matrix rows, F6=developer/microservice-main.md Step 0c three-branch dispatch. Parallel-safe git constraints unchanged. PO retro-audit signal unchanged.

edit_list.description: New SSOT file. Seven sections: (1) Profile Selection gate at top — FULL (new apps/<svc>/) vs LEAN (feature on existing service), architect classifies at handoff; (2) three-tier sequence pointer with FULL/LEAN scope note; (3) G1-G12 DoD pointer — FULL=all 12 hard gates, LEAN=G1-G6 mandatory + architect annotates which others apply; (4) sandbox security clause inline — applies to BOTH profiles, hard block; (5) dashboard requirement — FULL=three-level file:// render, LEAN=honest red/green only (1 failing test before green); (6) role relay — FULL=PO-BA-architect-PM-dev-QA, LEAN=dev-<svc> solo; (7) pilot-status SSOT convention — FULL=create new file from schema, LEAN=update existing only, never create per-feature file. ≤120 L. DRY.

edit_list.description: Step 5: replace any previous BUILD-STANDARD: required block with a two-branch (+ fallthrough) emit. NEW SERVICE (apps/<svc>/ does not exist) → BUILD-STANDARD: full + BUILD-STANDARD-REF + PILOT-STATUS-SSOT + ROLE-RELAY annotation. NEW FEATURE (apps/<svc>/ already exists) → BUILD-STANDARD: lean + BUILD-STANDARD-REF + solo-dev note. BUG-FIX/REFACTOR/MAINTENANCE → BUILD-STANDARD: not-applicable. Ambiguous scope defaults to lean with visibility note for PM. Classification is architect's call.

Branch 1 (BUILD-STANDARD: full): load standard (fail_loud)+charter (fail_loud)+07-phases + verify/create pilot-status-<svc>.json + apply full three-tier+G1-G12 + engage QA at Phase 2. Branch 2 (BUILD-STANDARD: lean): load standard only (fail_loud) + apply three-tier placement+fence+sandbox/replay+honest red/green + drive solo end-to-end. Branch 3 (not-applicable/absent): skip, maintenance mode.

parallel_safe_constraints: Explicit file staging only: git add <path> per file, never -A or .
Do NOT write to any active pilot-status-*.json (active terminals own those files)
Use lock-retry idiom per docs/protocols/head-lock-self-cure.md §F4 on all commits
No --amend, no --force-push — new commit for each change
Read each target file before editing (scoped reads, no blind Write)
